1 زَعَفَهُ , (S, K,) aor.
رَعَفَ , (K,) inf. n. زَعْفٌ, (S,) He, or it, killed him on the spot; (S, K;) as also ↓ ازعفهُ , and ↓ ازدعفهُ ; (K;) the last mentioned by As, as syn. with أَقْعَصَهُ: (TA:) or cast, or shot, at him, or smote him, so that he died on the spot, quickly: (L, TA:) and killed him quickly. (S.) ―
-b2- See also 4. ＝
-A2- زَعَفَ فِى حَدِيثِهِ He added, or exaggerated, or he lied, in his discourse, or narration. (Mj, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
